sources.title: Gte Modernbert Base - ModelBeacon
sources.snippet: GTE ModernBERT base is a compact embeddings and reranking model built on modernBERT that performs strongly on retrieval benchmarks like MTEB, LoCO, and COIR. It is designed for efficient semantic search, reranking, and embedding generation at moderate cost and low latency.

sources.title: gte-modernbert-base · Models
sources.snippet: The gte-modernbert series models include both text embedding models and rerank models. The gte-modernbert models demonstrates competitive performance in several text embedding and text retrieval evaluation tasks when compared to similar-scale models from the current open-source community.
